mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 1.5% triggers a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a low unemployment rate and a strong increase in payroll employment signals a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment and strong payroll growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production signals a weakening supply environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of declining industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts above 1.2 million units triggers a strong demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in strong demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a low federal funds rate and a strong increase in GDP growth rate signals an accommodative monetary environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low interest rates and strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% triggers a tight labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tight labor market periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a strong increase in retail sales and a low unemployment rate signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong retail sales and low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).
